calls.title: Jason - Sr Product Designer - R3 Behavioral & Culture Fit
calls.summary: Jason Cozy presented his diverse background in design and product management, particularly in UX, noting significant experience from a four-year California Community College project that required comprehensive product development. He discussed his adaptability to both agile and waterfall project lifecycles, leveraging data-driven insights and early feedback to improve product outcomes. Jason emphasized the importance of collaboration in cross-functional teams and highlighted his strategies for balancing client needs with scalable solutions. He actively integrates AI tools into his workflow, acknowledging their limitations while still valuing creativity in nuanced design aspects. His ability to manage multiple projects aligns well with the dynamic environment of the company, making him a suitable candidate for their team.
calls.keywords: Product design, agile workflows, client collaboration, AI in design, prioritization, squad model
